card.name: The word year before a date
card.fires_on: The word "year" right after "the" (or a number word) when it introduces or discusses a specific calendar year, such as "the year 1642". It also fires on "-year" in spans like "three-year".

modes.label: Year before a date
modes.description: The word "year" after "the" that is followed by a specific year number or era reference.
modes.example: the eighth century, when Tibet was a major empire; the<< year>> 1642 when the fifth

modes.label: Year in a span or calendar
modes.description: "year" or "-year" in a duration, a calendar-system label, or inside a year number.
modes.example: Results of a three<<-year>> inventory programme confirm the wealth of the flora

card.writes: It seems to push toward time-unit words like "daily" and "/day", but the effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "year" when the text is about to name a particular calendar year.
